title: SG-2 Typed asset manifest and validated content schemas
summary: Typed, zod-validated asset manifest and world object schemas with a non-crashing manifest loader
description: Context: game/ has YAML-based content (game/src/content/loader.ts) and a hardcoded ASSET_PATHS/HOTSPOTS map in game/frontend/src/runtime/assets.ts. Desired behavior: typed interfaces plus zod validators for the asset manifest and world objects, scene/location content under game/src/content/worlds/the-boys-room, the asset folder tree, and a loader that reports missing assets without crashing. Why: future AI cycles can add or replace assets without rewriting the engine.
acceptance_criteria: Given a manifest and world content, When validated, Then typed zod schemas accept valid data and reject invalid data with path-specific errors
Given a manifest reference to a file that does not exist, When the loader runs, Then it reports the asset as missing and does not throw
Given the repo, When listing game/public/assets, Then worlds/the-boys-room/{backgrounds,furniture,objects,characters,effects,audio} and ui/{icons,frames,cursors} exist

preserve: existing game/content YAML loader and its tests

definition_of_done: All requirements, Act and Verify units complete
